headline: Agents follow 96% of delivered directives (the literal judge misjudges 58% of them), but only 21% of deliveries change behaviour vs the randomised control; the realised-vs-offered gap is timing and visibility, not uptake: post-hoc delivery of the .venv reflex realises 2.09 calls per trigger but only 1.33 per dead-end session as logged (40% of the 3.36 a pre-emptive, once-per-session, uplift-gated delivery offers), worth ~3.0 calls (~9%) and ~$0.016 (~6%) per Haiku Python session, below the 15-20% target.
metric_name: calls (and $) saved per dead-end session, trigger/first need -> first test run that ran tests; plus p_follow and uplift (p_follow - p_self) per directive

session_level_DR_deliver_all_vs_withhold.note: pass-rate: conditional on a triggered unit, uncorrected for 6 comparisons; full-arm ITT is -0.02 [-0.10, 0.04]

leave_one_repo_out.vue_core_note: 2 delivered v1 `pnpm test` triggers both ended worse (16, 14 calls vs 2, 1): the only misfire signal, n=2

vs_baseline: Baseline U11 + learned reflexes: about +1.0 S-hat calls/session post-hoc, +2.11 pre-emptive. Live, the post-hoc reflex realises 1.33 calls per dead-end session, about 1.2 per Haiku Python session. Pre-emptive once-per-session delivery (direct method) gives 3.36 per dead-end session, about 3.0 per session: +1.8 calls/session over today, $0.016/session. Uplift-gating removes 79% of deliveries at no measurable loss.
hard_coded_parts: measurement instrument judge.instrument_match (shell peeling, activate->venv python, -m module, file-arg detection); used only to score the learned judge
measurement instrument analysis.gtest (G_test regex: N passed/failed, collected N items, runner summaries): the local goal event
instrument check of the learned dead-end-hit detector: 'No module named|command not found'
unfitted thresholds TAU_INTENT=0.6 (same-intent containment) and TAU_SAME_OUT=0.9 (potion output cosine)
directive text parser and wording features read Adage's own directive templates
the learned judge uses a generic lexer (non-word chars and '/', first line); no tool names or command lists

ceiling.per_haiku_python_session: about 3.0 calls (9%) and $0.016 (6%): the delivery lever cannot exceed what the directive offers, and on RepoBench only the env dead end (and the after-edit test run) offers anything

generated_repo_acme_preemptive_vs_hooks_.note: secondary, generated repo with traps; AGENTS.md does better (-17.3 calls)

build_recommendation: 1) Replace pattern::meets in the runtime follow judge and should_extinguish with learned weighted token containment. Weights are log(1+tasks) from the repo's traces and tau = 0.86. It stops U11 extinguishing, which protects the 2.09 calls per trigger. 2) Gate and rank by uplift (p_follow - p_self). Estimate p_self per route from control/would_have units with the same judge, and suppress uplift < 0.1: lookup, read-batch, finish obligations and prompt-time test advice here, 79% of deliveries. 3) Deliver valuable routes pre-emptively and once per session, as a PreToolUse rewrite or deny-with-reason at the first matching attempt, or a SessionStart line. This also covers piped exit-0 failures and Sonnet, for +2.0 calls and +$0.012 per dead-end session (+1.8 calls per Haiku Python session). 4) Do not add every-time repetition or explanatory wording: there were 0 relapses in 46 sessions, and p_follow is at ceiling for every wording.
